name: dsh-aoci-panel
description: AOCI 认知面板：多工作区总览、认知视图（价值卡、变更账本、开发须知、认知地图、健康时间线、资产清单）、单仓库索引与治理状态、绑定诊断、索引文件管控（aoci.txt / aoci.meta.txt / aoci.code.txt 的可视化编辑、结构校验、备份与恢复）、快捷动作与提示词，并为未接入的项目提供单仓库与批量引导式初始化；内置 AOCI 接入工具（aoci_bind_status / aoci_bind_repair / aoci_project_init / aoci_doctor，合并自 dsh-aoci-bind），用于发现、诊断、修复 MCP 绑定并初始化未接入的仓库。
author: donyue7

scripts.test: node --test scripts/test-cognition.mjs scripts/test-host.mjs scripts/test-assets.mjs scripts/test-host-routes.mjs test/bind/yamlpatch.test.mjs test/bind/discovery.test.mjs test/bind/binding.test.mjs test/bind/tools.test.mjs test/bind/plugin.test.mjs && node scripts/test-client-cognition.mjs
